Combat is accompanied by frequent sprays of blood and dismemberment as players exterminate the alien forces or players and squad mates are hit by environmental explosions or friendly fire. Enemy encampments and battlefield environments depict bloodstains and dismembered corpses.

Fantasy blood-like substance, coming from robot enemies, appears in comical amounts during gameplay.
Billboards appear in certain levels, parodying ads for tobacco, pharmaceutical drugs, and crime PSAs.

threeSentenceVerdict.coreHook: Only one source backs this verdict so far (Steam at 95%). The score is provisional.
threeSentenceVerdict.flaw: Single-source verdicts miss blind spots — wait for a second source before treating this as settled.
threeSentenceVerdict.targetAudience: Early adopters comfortable with uncertainty; cautious buyers should wishlist and revisit.
